hooks.command: bash -c 'LOG="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/acd/codex-hook.log"; LOG_DIR="$(dirname "$LOG")"; [ -d "$LOG_DIR" ] || mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true; { read -r SID; read -r CWD; } < <(acd hook-stdin-extract session_id cwd? <&0 2>>"$LOG") || exit 0; REPO="${CWD:-$PWD}"; acd start --session-id "$SID" --harness codex --watch-pid "$PPID" --repo "$REPO" >/dev/null 2>>"$LOG" || { printf '"'"'[%s] session-start failed exit=%d cmd=acd-start\n'"'"' "$(date +%FT%T%z)" "$?" >>"$LOG"; exit 1; }'
